description:
THE COMPREHENSIVE SOLUTION TO LEARNING DISABILITIES
Permanently eliminate difficulties associated with learning disabilities, dyslexia, auditory processing, and attention challenges at Stowell Learning Center.


ABOUT STOWELL LEARNING CENTERS
Through targeted brain training, we have helped thousands of students over the last 40 years to permanently eliminate struggles associated with dyslexia, auditory processing, and other learning disabilities.

Our goal for each student, regardless of age, is that he/she becomes as comfortable and independent a learner as possible. In order to do this, we work closely with parents, communicate with schools, and are continually seeking to find and implement the most effective, research-based, efficient strategies and programs. We work with a very comprehensive continuum of learning skills that allows us to create programming for each student that is very specific to his or her needs.
